column1: # Two-block tall grains (Ronald, 11-04; Plants wires them): stage 2 and 3 of maize, sorghum and pearl millet as a bottom half
# Installed: each _bottom over the crop's <crop>_stage_N.png (the one-block tiles archived), each _top as <crop>_stage_N_top.png.
# and a top half drawn in one image, the top directly above the bottom (top right over bottom right, top left over bottom left),
# so the stalks join. BLOCK_LIKE=<crop>_stage_2,<crop>_stage_3 per image (the crop's current tiles, for colour).

column3: maize_stage_2_top|crop|Maize stage 3 of 4, TOP HALF of a two-block plant: tall green maize stalks continuing up from the bottom edge (they continue the bottom half below, 4 stalks across, the same places), long arching strap leaves, ending in pale pink-cream tassels at the very top 4-8 px below the top edge, colours like the attached maize
column4: maize_stage_3_top|crop|Maize stage 4 of 4 (ripe), TOP HALF of a two-block plant: tall yellowing maize stalks continuing up from the bottom edge (they continue the bottom half below, 4 stalks across), drying leaves, golden-orange tassels at the top 4-8 px below the top edge, colours like the attached ripe maize
column5: maize_stage_2_bottom|crop|Maize stage 3 of 4, BOTTOM HALF of a two-block plant: 4 thick green maize stalks rising from the bottom edge to the TOP edge (they continue into the top half above), with long arching strap leaves, no tassels; colours like the attached maize
column6: maize_stage_3_bottom|crop|Maize stage 4 of 4 (ripe), BOTTOM HALF of a two-block plant: 4 thick yellowing maize stalks rising from the bottom edge to the TOP edge (they continue into the top half above), drying leaves and one plump golden ear with husk on each stalk; colours like the attached ripe maize

column3: sorghum_stage_2_top|crop|Sorghum stage 3 of 4, TOP HALF of a two-block plant: 3 tall green sorghum stalks continuing up from the bottom edge (they continue the bottom half below, the same places), long strap leaves, each ending in a compact green seed head 6-8 px tall near the top, colours like the attached sorghum
column4: sorghum_stage_3_top|crop|Sorghum stage 4 of 4 (ripe), TOP HALF of a two-block plant: 3 tall sorghum stalks continuing up from the bottom edge (they continue the bottom half below), each ending in a dense deep-red seed head 7-9 px tall near the top, colours like the attached ripe sorghum
column5: sorghum_stage_2_bottom|crop|Sorghum stage 3 of 4, BOTTOM HALF of a two-block plant: 3 green sorghum stalks rising from the bottom edge to the TOP edge (they continue into the top half above), long arching strap leaves, no heads; colours like the attached sorghum
column6: sorghum_stage_3_bottom|crop|Sorghum stage 4 of 4 (ripe), BOTTOM HALF of a two-block plant: 3 sorghum stalks rising from the bottom edge to the TOP edge (they continue into the top half above), leaves starting to yellow, no heads; colours like the attached ripe sorghum

column3: millet_stage_2_top|crop|Pearl millet stage 3 of 4, TOP HALF of a two-block plant: 5 slender green stalks continuing up from the bottom edge (they continue the bottom half below, the same places), long thin leaves, each ending in a straight green cylindrical spike (candle) 8-10 px tall near the top, colours like the attached millet
column4: millet_stage_3_top|crop|Pearl millet stage 4 of 4 (ripe), TOP HALF of a two-block plant: 5 slender stalks continuing up from the bottom edge (they continue the bottom half below), each ending in a straight tan-golden cylindrical spike (candle) 8-10 px tall near the top, colours like the attached ripe millet
column5: millet_stage_2_bottom|crop|Pearl millet stage 3 of 4, BOTTOM HALF of a two-block plant: 5 slender green stalks rising from the bottom edge to the TOP edge (they continue into the top half above), long thin grass-like leaves, no spikes; colours like the attached millet
column6: millet_stage_3_bottom|crop|Pearl millet stage 4 of 4 (ripe), BOTTOM HALF of a two-block plant: 5 slender stalks rising from the bottom edge to the TOP edge (they continue into the top half above), leaves drying to straw, no spikes; colours like the attached ripe millet
